none: PAS NLM-9AECE2: Roman Denarius of Hadrian
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver Coin: Denarius of Hadrian (117-138). Obverse description: Bust laureate facing right. Obverse inscription: HADRIANVS/AVGCOSIIIPP Reverse description: Fortuna seated left with rudder and cornucopiae Obverse inscription: FORTVNAE/REDV[C]I Mint: Rome, Issued 134-138. Reference: RIC no. 247, Diameter: 18.58mm, 3.13gms, die axis: 12
